## Context

<!-- What is wrong or missing, for whom, and why it matters now, and the requirement or the decision that asks for it. Give the facts and the numbers in the text itself: a reader understands the issue with no link opened. A citation is a link right after the sentence it supports. -->

## Decision

<!-- What was decided, by whom (owner or orchestrator), and when. The options that were rejected, in 1 line each, with the reason. A wait is not written here: it is a "blocked by" link or the board field "Waiting on". -->

## Work

<!-- What to do, as a short list. The files or the areas it touches. -->

**Done when:** <!-- a result that can be seen -->

## Outcome

<!-- Filled when the issue closes: what was built or found, the numbers, the version shipped, and what is still open (with its issue). "Not done yet" while open. -->

## How to review

<!-- The steps for the owner to check the outcome: the page to open and what to look at, the command to run and the result to expect, or the note to read and the section. "Nothing to review" when that is true. -->
